parts.text: Prove that there are four distinct intersections exactly when $h>3$.
parts.answer: 当h<3右侧负而左侧非负，无解；h=3只有t=4；h>3时 $t=(h+5\pm\sqrt{(h-3)(h+13)})/2$ 为两个不同正数，各给两个相反的x。
parts.explanation: h>3时h+5>8且根号严格小于h+5，因为平方差16×4=64；故较小t仍正。
